## Read in pre-adjustment data

```{r}
# sector 1: Fishing (cf)
cf_df_pre <- read_csv(here(int_dir, "eco_cf_usd_pre.csv"))

# sector 2: Mariculture (mar)
mar_df_pre <- read_csv(here(int_dir, "eco_mar_usd_pre.csv"))

# sector 3: Tourism (tour)
tour_df_pre <- read_csv(here(int_dir, "eco_tour_usd_pre.csv"))

```

## Implement `inflation_adjustment.R`

```{r}
# Fishing (cf)
cf_df_adj <- inflation_adjustment(cf_df_pre, conversion_date = 2017, country = "US", current_year = current_year)


# Mariculture (mar)
mar_df_adj <- inflation_adjustment(mar_df_pre, conversion_date = 2017, country = "US", current_year = current_year)


# Tourism (tour)
tour_df_adj <- inflation_adjustment(tour_df_pre, conversion_date = 2017, country = "US", current_year = current_year)


```
## Combine adjusted dataframes 

```{r}
# bind rows of adjusted dataframes
eco_usd_bind <- rbind(cf_df_adj, mar_df_adj, tour_df_adj)

# find maximum and minimum years for each adjusted dataframe
min_max_df <- tibble(
  min_year = c(min(cf_df_adj$year), min(mar_df_adj$year), min(tour_df_adj$year)),
  max_year = c(max(cf_df_adj$year), max(mar_df_adj$year), max(tour_df_adj$year))
)

# set year range based on limiting dataset values
start_year <- max(min_max_df$min_year)
stop_year <- min(min_max_df$max_year)

# ----- create aggregated adjusted dataframe ------------
eco_usd_adj <- eco_usd_bind %>% 
  filter(year %in% c(start_year:stop_year)) %>% # filter to date range
  group_by(rgn_id, rgn_name, year) %>% # group by places & years
  summarize(value = sum(adj_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # sum values
  mutate(value = case_when( 
    value == 0 ~ NA, # replace 0s with NAs (flag of no data that was lost in summing)
    .default = value
  ))



# write dataframe to int
#write_csv(eco_usd_adj, here(int_dir, "eco_usd_adj.csv"))

```
